caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden mortar and pestle placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The mortar is cylindrical with a wider top and a narrower midsection that flares back out at the base. The wood is brown with visible grain and texture, including natural irregularities and cracks. The pestle, also made of wood and of similar color, is partially inside the mortar, with its rounded end and handle extending upward at an angle. There are no other objects or details in the scene aside from a small, neat signature reading "Carl Buergerriss" in the lower right corner. The composition is simple and the objects are rendered with realistic surface details.
title: Mortar and Pestle
